item.title: Body found in canal identified as missing woman Lupita Ontiveros
item.description: The body of Lupita Lizbeth Zuniga-Ontiveros, a Stockton mother who went missing in January after an early morning crash into the Delta Mendota Canal, was recovered seven miles downstream from the crash site.
